name: Earth satellites
blurb: Low-Earth and polar-orbiting satellites around Earth — crewed stations (ISS, Tiangong with Tianhe/Wentian/Mengtian), Hubble, and major weather and Earth-science missions (NOAA/MetOp, Terra/Aqua/Aura, Landsat, Sentinel, ICESat-2, SWOT, CALIPSO, GCOM-W1).
highlights: Crewed laboratories in LEO (ISS and China Space Station modules)
Polar weather: NOAA-15/18/19/20, Suomi NPP, MetOp-B/C
Earth science: Terra, Aqua, Aura, CloudSat, CALIPSO, GCOM-W1, Landsat, Sentinel, ICESat-2, SWOT
compactnessNote: These spacecraft fly a few hundred to about 800 km above Earth's surface, far closer than the Moon.
